_comment: Rule v2, pre-registered 2026-11-15 for FUTURE events. The scoring is pipeline/config.json, unchanged. What changes is the unit of success: the zone a valley sensor could watch, not the exact slope. The zone size and list length were chosen AFTER seeing the Langtang and Budhi Gandaki results (data/sensitivity_zone.json), so those two events are development data for v2, not tests of it.

zone.drainage_test: rank.py same_channel: the patch's D8 path joins the failure's D8 path before the main stem

success: a top-10 patch inside the zone in EITHER of the last two ascending passes that were public on ASF before the event
also_report: coverage of BOTH of the last two passes
per-pass coverage against chance (hypergeometric) and its Poisson-binomial p-value
distinct valleys on the list per pass (the sensor cost)
the exact-slope result (2 km, top 5) for continuity with v1

development_results_not_tests.langtang: 6 of 7 passes covered (chance 4.7); last two passes: #19, #1 within 5 km
development_results_not_tests.budhigandaki: 7 of 11 passes covered (chance 3.6, p 0.026); last two passes: #5, #9 within 5 km

next_events: every slope failure in the NISAR era with at least two public pre-event pairs on one track, starting with Lete (Kali Gandaki) once its scar is mapped

_committed.subject: Pre-register rule v2 for future events: 5 km zone, top 10
